description: This file defines numeric types, conversion functions, and bit array classes within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes templates for number handling, serialization, network byte order conversions, and bit manipulation utilities.

classes.name: NumberType
classes.description: Template class for handling numeric types with serialization, conversion, and comparison functionalities.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Class representing fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts.

classes.name: BitArrayBaseType
classes.description: Base template class for fixed-size bit array manipulation.

classes.name: BitArrayType
classes.description: Derived class for fixed-size bit array.

classes.name: BitArrayFlexType
classes.description: Derived class for flexible-size bit array.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Static template methods for converting string representations to numeric types.

methods.name: TypedAbs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the number, specialized for signed/unsigned types.

methods.name: TypedNegative
methods.description: Checks if the number is negative, specialized for signed/unsigned types.

methods.name: TypedMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value for the type, signed or unsigned.

methods.name: TypedMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for the type, signed or unsigned.

methods.name: Composit
methods.description: Template method to combine integer and remainder parts into a floating-point number.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns string representation of the number with specified decimal places.
